item.description: Electricity Distribution Companies (DisCos) operating in Nigeria metered a total of 106,822 customers in October 2025, achieving a 56.07 per cent national metering rate within the period. item.title: ‘Sack Farming’ initiative offers lifeline to women with disabilities in Nasarawa
